translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Aeiineon Miniwe Gupwunon Appwiuniupai
Iwe, Jesus a pwan kkepas ngaeniir aeremas kkewe noan fioangon awewe.
“Mweoiu Naaeng eweei minneen. Eno erhai king e oamoannatae aaen mwaaen we naiun gupwunon appwiuniupai.
A fangenoa naiun rhooan engaang pwe repwe noa faingiir to waseona kkewe repwe itto tapweei gupwun we, nge rese mwerhaen itto.

Mwirin a pwan fangenoa aaemweoi rhooan engaang pwe repwe noa aengaeniir aeremas pwe: ‘Igina, aaei gupwun a moannotae; naeyi wakke me man pwetaei kkewe naiiur ra niir noa, iwe oanongan nge a moannotae. Oaw itto tapweei gupwuneen.’
Nge rhooawe re faingiir rese tepa, iwe ra siunoa: erhai a noa ngaeni aan menaai, nge erhai a noa ngaeni aan nenien chuwaai,
nge pwan aaemweoi ra torofiir rhooan engaang kkewe, ra wirhiir nge ra niir noa.
Iwe king we a igin soong, iwe a fangenoa sonotaw kkewe pwe repwe noa niir noa rhooawe renni menaw iwe me figinoa aepinoamwoor.
Iwe a faingiir to rhooan engaang kkewe naiun nge a aengaeniir pwe, ‘Aaei gupwunon appwiuniupai a moannotae, nge waseona kkewe i faingiir pwe repwe itto tapweei gupwuneen nge ese fin pwe repwe itto.
Iwe oawnoa wooan ennap temoag kena pwe oawpwe faingiir to oanongeer aeremas kka oaw rhuungiir.’

Iwe rhooan engaang kkewe ra faaeraeg wow wooan ennap kkewe nge ra faingiir oanongeer aeremas kka re rhuungiir, ese tiwegin aere aeremas gacch aere aeremas aenneew, iwe a sseog noa imwaen gupwun we reer waseona.
“Igiwe king we a toonong noan iimw we pwe epwe pipiiy rhooan gupwun kkewe, a weri erhai mwaaen ese memmengaag min mwamwaai to reen appwiuniupai we.
Iwe king we a aeiineow pwe, ‘Maereyaerei, ifa wusun oamw toonong igeei, nge wose memmengaag min mwamwaai to reen appwiuniupai eei?’ Nge mwaaen we ese paniuwaeni.
Iwe king we a aengaeniir rhooan engaang kkewe pwe, ‘Oaw geoni paiun me pirheen nge oawwa oatorawow noan rorhappiung, iga epwe sessaeng nge akkaarengi me ee.’ ”
Nge Jesus a iura pwe, “Re towunap rhooawe re faingiir, nge fitiman rhag re finiir.”
Kkepas Aeiineon Tax
Pharisees kkewe ra noa nge ra pwiungiuw fengaenniy pwe repwe aettefaeti reen aar kkepas aeiineo.

Ra fangenoa aaemweoi rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiiur reen Jesus me aaemweoi rhinaen Erotes. Nge ra aengaeni pwe, “Sinsei, aemaem aei giuneei pwe een wo aepesa minikka ennet. Wa fenaiuw minikka ennet pwe wunuunun nee tipaen Deus ngaeniir aeremas, nge wose niuwaennei minikka aeremas ra aeni niunniuwaen, nge wose niuwaennei wunuunun erhai me erhai.
Iwe, aengaenigemaem meeta oamw niunniuwaen. E mwamwaai aarh sipwe fang tax ngaeni Soamwoonin Rome, aere aapw?”
Nge Jesus e giuneei aar niunniuwaen aenneew, iwe a aengaeniir pwe, “Aaemi rhooa oatupwutupw! Meeta oaw mwerhaen pwe oawpwe soatoniaei reen?
Oaw pwaeri ngaeniaei senaapiy mwu oawpwe fang pwe tax!” Iwe, ra pwigito reen efai senaapiy.
Nge Jesus a aeiineeor pwe, “Mesaen iyo me itaen iyo een?”
Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Soamwoonin Rome.” Iwe Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Iwe, oawfang ngaeni Soamwoonin Rome meeta aaen Soamwoonin Rome, nge oawfang ngaeni Deus meeta aaen Deus.”
Oatowe re rongorong kkepas we, ra mwaar noa reen, iwe ra siusaengi.
Kkepas Aeiineon Menaw Sefaaen
Noan raaenin we rhag nge aaemweoi Sadducees ra itto reen Jesus ra iura pwe aeremas resoapw menaw sefaaen me reen mae.

Iwe, ra aepesa pwe, “Sinsei, Moses a iura pwe ngaere erhai mwaaen a maenoa nge esooar naiun, ina nge mwaaen we pwiin epwe pwiuniuwaeni rhooapwut we pwe epwe yor naiun pwe epwe ffai pwe naiun mwaaen we a mae.
Iwe, eyor fiusiuman pwipwi re fasiun nonno igeei. Iwe mwaaen we e tugufaeyi a pwiuniuwaeni erhai rhooapwut, nge a maenoa nge esooar naiun, iwe a nigiti niewe ngaeni wonowe pwiin.
Taeppen rhag meeta we ewen ngaeni iwe ariiurhaiun me iwe aeiniurhaiun toori oanongeer noa rhooawe fiusiuman.
Mwirin noan, nge rhooapwut we a maenoa.
Iwe, noan raaenin na manimae repwene menaw sefaaen, iyo me neeiir rhooawe fiusiuman minne pwiuniuwaen rhooapwut we? Igiwe oanongeer nge re pwiuniuwaeni niewe.”
Nge Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Aaemi oawwa mwaerhei, pwe iga aaemi oawse giuneei oawton Pwapwior we e Santus ngaere minikkena maemaewaen Deus.
Pwe oate rhooa mae repwe menaw sefaaen, repwene aeffitaeg ngaeniir rhag angkenusun naaeng nge resoapw pwiuppwiuniuw no.
Iwe nge reer manimae iga repwe menaw sefaaen tae: esaaen yor mwo aaemi aeraegi meeta we Deus e aengaenigaemi? Iwe e aepesa pwe,
‘Ngaang aaen Abraham Deus, aaen Isaac Deus me aaen Jacob Deus.’ Iiy aar Deus rhooakka re menaw, nge saapw aar Deus rhooakka remae.”
Igiwe pwuwaen aeremas kkewe ra rongorong kkepas kkewe, ra mwaar noa reen aan fenai.
Anniug we Oarosaen Taegias
Oatowe Pharisees ra rongorong noa pwe Sadducees kkewe ra iugiu noa pwe resa giuneei no minne repwe paniuwaeni ngaeni Jesus, iir ra rhu fengaen,
nge erhai me neeiir, erhai sinsein anniug, a aegina ne soatoni Jesus reen aan kkepas aeiineo.
A aeiineow pwe, “Sinsei, ifa oasoapwosoapw e oarosaen taegias me neeiin oanongaen Anniug?”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Wopwe aerhaengi Soamwoon na oamw Deus reen oanongaen nee tipoamw, reen oanongaen ngeoniumw pwan reen oanongaen oamw niunniuwaen.
Ieei minne e oarosaen taegias me yor ipitan me neeiin oanongan oasoapwosoapw.
Nge oaruwowwaen oasoapwosoapw epwan taegias nge: ‘Wopwe aerhaengiir rhooan weni oaromw taeppen rhag oamw sipegin aerhaengi oanongoamw.’
Oanongaen aaen Moses Anniug me aar profeta kkewe pwapwior nge re oanongonong rhag wooan oasoapwosoapw kka ruwowu.”
Kkepas Aeiineon Iyo na Kristus
Igiwe aaemweoi Pharisees ra rhu fengaen, Jesus a aeiineeor pwe,
“Meeta oaw niuwaennei reen Kristus? Iiy teoteeon iyo?” Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Iiy teoteeon David.”
Jesus a aeiineeor pwe, “Meeta rhag nge Espritu Santus a aemeyaefi ngaeni David aan epwe faingi pwe ‘Soamwoon’? Iwe David a aepesa,

content.text: toori aaei ipwe iseniir tiw rhooan oapwutoag faaen pirhemw.’

content: Iwe, ngaere David e faingi ngaeni pwe iiy ‘Soamwoon’, ifa wusun nge Kristus epwe no pwe teoteeon David?”
Esooar erhai ne emmwenen paniuwaeni kkepas aeiyeg kkewe aaen Jesus, iwe saengi rhag noan raaenin we nge esooar no ne e rhiuwen mwerhaen pwe epwe aeiineow aekkaew kkepas aeiineo.
